messages:
maria_ops: Heads-up — scheduling a short maintenance window for apac-edge tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. We’ll do staggered warm reboots across 4 racks to clear a nvlink jitter issue. Expect transient capacity dips but no forced tenant evictions.

alex_dev: Rough capacity impact estimate? want to warn PLG teams.

maria_ops: Ballpark 10-20% throughput dip on apac-edge during each rack reboot, lasting ~10-15m per rack. We'll throttle low-priority pools and route critical traffic to us-east as needed.

sam_infra: Proposed flow: cordon -> drain non-critical jobs -> soft-reboot GPUs -> verify NV link counters -> uncordon. Rolling window: one rack every 18 minutes. We'll preheat KV cache after each uncordon.

jordan_sre: Any scheduled batch jobs from partners? I can quickly scan backlog.

maria_ops: Found two partner batch runs at 02:25 and 02:40. I’ve DM'ed partner teams to nudge. If they can't move, we'll shift their workloads to apac-backfill pool and tag for quota chargeback.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: MNT-2026-0420-APAC-EDGE (https://infra.redwood/mnt/MNT-2026-0420-APAC-EDGE) — planners: @maria_ops, @sam_infra.

alex_dev: Cost note — backfilling to other regions likely to add ~3k GPU-minutes. Can we cap cross-region backfill to avoid surprise bill?

sam_infra: Yes — default policy will only allow cross-region backfill if projected extra GPU-minutes < 2k. Otherwise, we fallback to spot backfill within APAC pool.

maria_ops: Canary plan: reboot rack-3 first, wait 20m, monitor KV hit-rate + tail-latency. Abort conditions: packet loss >0.5% for 5m, KV hit-rate drop >30%, or customer error rate spike.

alex_dev: Add a smoke test to validate model latency after uncordon (small prompt set).

maria_ops: Added. Also dropping a short runbook snippet here for on-call: 

```
# maintenance runbook excerpt
fleetctl cordon rack-3
fleetctl drain --pool=lowprio --grace=120 rack-3
ansible-playbook reboot-rack.yml -e rack=rack-3
wait_for_kvseed.py --rack rack-3 --min-hitrate 0.75
fleetctl uncordon rack-3
```

jordan_sre: @maria_ops please add alerts on the dashboard for KV hit-rate < 70% and tail-latency > 200ms. Also add a metric for dropped NVLink packets.

maria_ops: Done — dashboard row "APAC Edge Maintenance" created and shared. Also added automated rollback: if tail-latency breach persists >10m we switch affected routes to quantized-model fallback on Dedicated.

sam_infra: I'll be primary on-call for the window. @alex_dev you good to run the smoke prompts?

alex_dev: Yup — I'll be standing by and will post results to this thread. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: Thanks team. Will post 30m prior reminder and the exact rack order. If anyone spots anything odd pre-window, ping here or DM.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m before MNT-2026-0420-APAC-EDGE.

alex_dev: quick q — are we adjusting autoscaler thresholds during the window?

sam_infra: Yes — temporarily lower target utilization to avoid aggressive bin-packing. Policy will revert 10m after final uncordon.

jordan_sre: +1 on lowering. Also note to SRE rotation: please hold major deploys to apac-edge for 1 hour after maintenance ends.

maria_ops: Copy. Closing the loop here; will update with rack sequence in 15m.

sam_infra: :robot_face: will post health-checks to #incidents channel during the window.
